summary: The filing is a Form 6-K containing notice of an Annual General and Special Meeting of Aura Minerals Inc., along with proxy materials. The meeting, scheduled for June 16, 2026, covers routine items: reelection of directors, appointment of auditors, and approval of amended articles. The board recommends voting for all resolutions. There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing with no special-situation event.
